title: Bind the existing receipt and prepare the clean independent input snapshot

handoff.objective: Bind the existing receipt and prepare the clean independent input snapshot
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Exact evidence custody and scoped independent review publication.
constraints: Zero scientific trials, formal builds, formalization runs, solver sweeps and benchmarks.
Preserve original sources, proof/specification/receipt bytes and existing statuses. No new EV/DEC/H records, scientific promotion, global lower bound, speedup or goal completion.
Only driving Coordinator performs Git, claims, publication, canonical queue updates and archive binding.
Missing custody/input/independence is an unresolved gate, never a mathematical negative or permission to fabricate an attestation.
Copy raw receipt exact bytes only; never normalize it, rewrite semantic_review or relabel its test-merge provenance.

Compare complete receipt workspace/verifier maps, disclose each mismatch/missing input, and bind current compatible closure explicitly; the four matching primary hashes alone do not certify the whole workspace.
Prepare isolated B directory with only blind-input.md, exact B card and AGENTS.md; no .git, hidden producer artifacts or inherited transcript. Record inventory and hashes.

publication-gate.json records prepared_unpublished until actual source archive/publication. No reviewer launches before source snapshot verifies, inputs are committed/pushed/reviewable, lane published and task claimed.
completion_gate: input-binding.json binds exact pre-dispatch plan, blind input, B card and isolated-directory hashes plus every compared receipt input.
Load-bearing mismatch blocks review pending an additive resolution; no verification rerun is authorized.
All exact declared artifacts present; actual commands, limitations and session provenance reported.
handoff.return_format: Artifact paths, checks, honest scope and unresolved gates.
